// Cyrus' ONE scheduler entry point (SERVER ONLY, worker process). The platform worker calls registerCyrusSweeps(runner)
// with a single line; every Cyrus background sweep, its cadence, its timeout and its off-switch live here, so moving
// Cyrus to its own worker means moving this file, not editing the platform's worker/index.ts.
// Cadences and behaviour are exactly what worker/index.ts registered before: tokens 5 min (timeout 3 min), AI-build
// sync 20 s (timeout 2 min), mod lifecycle 5 min and compat watch 6 h (both fire-and-forget, inert by their own Setting),
// Test Flight gate 2 min (inert unless CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_GATE=1, checked before any import).
import { getHost } from "../host";
import { sweepCyrusTokens } from "../tokens/sweep";

const MIN = 60_000;
const HOUR = 60 * MIN;

/** Anything shaped like the platform's SweepRunner.register (kept structural so this file imports nothing from it). */
export type CyrusSweepRunner = {
  register(def: { name: string; intervalMs: number; fn: () => Promise<unknown>; timeoutMs?: number }): unknown;
};

type Env = Record<string, string | undefined>;

export function registerCyrusSweeps(runner: CyrusSweepRunner, env: Env = process.env): void {
  const add = (name: string, intervalMs: number, fn: () => Promise<unknown>, timeoutMs?: number) =>
    runner.register({ name, intervalMs, fn, timeoutMs });

  // AI Mod Builder: advance in-flight builds from the build service so they finish (and the jar lands on disk) even with
  // no page open. A no-op query when nothing is building.
  add("modbuilder-sync", 20 * 1000, () => getHost().worker.syncModBuilds(), 2 * MIN);
  // Cyrus tokens: settle/release leftover build holds, expire due lots, reconcile plans with Stripe.
  add("cyrus-tokens", 5 * MIN, async () => { await sweepCyrusTokens(); }, 3 * MIN);
  // Mod lifecycle (Broken signals, crash-loop auto-disable, opt-in auto-updates) and creator warnings. Both inert by default.
  add("cyrus-lifecycle", 5 * MIN, async () => { void getHost().worker.modLifecycleSweep().catch((e) => console.error("[cyrus-lifecycle] sweep error", e)); });
  add("cyrus-compat-watch", 6 * HOUR, async () => { void getHost().worker.modCompatWatchSweep().catch((e) => console.error("[cyrus-compat] sweep error", e)); });
  // Test Flight gate: boot-test succeeded builds, one flight at a time. Inert unless CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_GATE=1.
  add("cyrus-testflight-gate", 2 * MIN, async () => {
    if (env.CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_GATE !== "1") return;
    void import("../testflight/gate-worker").then(async (g) => g.testFlightGateSweep(await g.defaultGateDeps())).catch((e) => console.error("[cyrus-testflight-gate] sweep error", e));
  });
}

/** The sound render relay: the web process renders through the worker, never by itself. Inert unless
 *  CYRUS_SOUND_RENDER=ssh AND CYRUS_SOUND_RELAY_PORT are set on the worker. Resolves true when it started. */
export async function startCyrusSoundRelay(env: Env = process.env): Promise<boolean> {
  if (env.CYRUS_SOUND_RENDER !== "ssh" || !env.CYRUS_SOUND_RELAY_PORT) return false;
  try {
    const { selectRenderHost } = await import("../sound/host");
    const { startRenderRelay, probeSshRenderHost } = await import("../sound/relay");
    const sel = selectRenderHost(env);
    if (!sel.ok) throw new Error(sel.reason);
    startRenderRelay({ host: sel.host, port: Number(env.CYRUS_SOUND_RELAY_PORT), token: env.CYRUS_SOUND_RELAY_TOKEN ?? "", probe: () => probeSshRenderHost({ host: env.CYRUS_SOUND_RENDER_HOST || undefined, root: env.CYRUS_SOUND_RENDER_ROOT || undefined, libraryDir: env.CYRUS_SOUND_LIBRARY_DIR || undefined, ffmpegDir: env.CYRUS_SOUND_FFMPEG_DIR || undefined }) });
    console.log(`[cyrus-sound-relay] listening on 127.0.0.1:${env.CYRUS_SOUND_RELAY_PORT}`);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { console.error("[cyrus-sound-relay] not started", e); return false; }
}

BEGIN
  IF NEW."id" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."id"
     OR NEW."projectId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."projectId"
     OR NEW."seq" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."seq"
     OR NEW."parentId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."parentId"
     OR NEW."kind" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."kind"
     OR NEW."spec" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."spec"
     OR NEW."manifest" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."manifest"
     OR NEW."modBuildId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."modBuildId"
     OR NEW."engine" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."engine"
     OR NEW."message" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."message"
     OR NEW."revertOfId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."revertOfId"
     OR NEW."createdAt" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."createdAt" THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CyrusRevision content is immutable (append-only)';
  END IF;
  IF NEW."status" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."status"
     AND NOT (OLD."status" = 'pending' AND NEW."status" IN ('passed', 'failed')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CyrusRevision status can only move from pending to passed or failed';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS cyrus_revision_immutable ON "CyrusRevision";
-- @stmt
CREATE TRIGGER cyrus_revision_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON "CyrusRevision"
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cyrus_revision_immutable();

#!/bin/bash
# Deploy a ref (default: main from /opt/nxeon) to the staging environment —
# without breaking the running staging app while it builds.
#
#   scripts/deploy-staging.sh [git-ref] [--dry-run] [--install-units] [--build-local]
#
# Same release model as promote-production.sh (see scripts/lib/seamless-release.sh):
# the build runs in /tank/nxeon-deploy/staging/build (a worktree of the
# /opt/nxeon-staging repo at origin/<ref>, with staging's .env), the finished
# .next becomes a release under /tank/nxeon-deploy/staging/releases/, gets a

#!/bin/bash
# Promote /opt/nxeon's committed HEAD to production — SEAMLESSLY.
#
#   scripts/promote-production.sh [--dry-run] [--accept-data-loss] [--install-units]
#                                 [--skip-staging-check] [--allow-dirty] [--build-local]
#
# The build NEVER happens in /opt/nxeon any more (that is what took the site
# half-down for 10-12 minutes per promote until 2026-10-01), and since
# 2026-10-07 not on this box at all: it runs on the BUILD HOST (node-2,
# nxeon-fsn1) in its capped nxeon-build-prod.slice. Instead:
#   1. a git worktree of HEAD at /tank/nxeon-deploy/production/build (ZFS pool;
#      the root disk is ~90% full) with production's .env copied in — used here
#      only for the schema, public/ and geoip data (npm install, no build);
#   2. HEAD is pushed to node-2's git mirror plus a build-time-only env (APP_URL;
#      no secrets — see scripts/lib/buildhost.sh); node-2 runs npm install,
#      prisma generate and `next build` (stall/overall watchdog, node-2's build
#      lock, 6-thread / 10 GB cap) and the finished .next is rsynced back
#      (verified: same BUILD_ID, same file list + sizes);
#   3. schema push to the production DB (additive by default — see below);
#   4. all the old post-build steps (public/ + .next/static + geoip data into
#      standalone, standalone/.env = production .env, chown for 'nxeon');
#   5. the finished .next becomes /tank/nxeon-deploy/production/releases/<id>/;
#   6. that release is booted on 127.0.0.1:3095 and smoke-tested first;
#   7. /opt/nxeon/.next (a SYMLINK to the live release) is swapped in one
#      atomic rename, nxeon-web restarted (downtime = the restart), and
#      /, a real /_next/static chunk, this build's _buildManifest.js and /login
#      must answer 200 — otherwise it AUTO-ROLLS BACK to the previous release;
#   8. only then: npm install + prisma generate in /opt/nxeon for the worker,
#      wait for in-flight PROVISION jobs (max 4 min), restart nxeon-worker;
#   9. keeps the current + 3 previous releases. Rollback any time:
#      scripts/rollback-release.sh --production [RELEASE_ID]
#
# Flags:
#   --build-local         EMERGENCY FALLBACK: build on THIS box like before
#                         2026-10-07 (node-2 unreachable/broken). Schema is then
#                         pushed before the build, as it always was.
#   --dry-run             build + stage + smoke-test only. No schema push (prints
#                         the SQL a push would run), no swap, no restarts.
#   --accept-data-loss    pass --accept-data-loss to `prisma db push`. Without
#                         it, a schema change Prisma flags as possibly
#                         destructive aborts the promote BEFORE anything changes
#                         (the old script always passed it).
#   --install-units       install changed deploy/*.service|*.timer into
#                         /etc/systemd/system + daemon-reload (default: print
#                         the diff command and the install command only).
#   --skip-staging-check  don't require staging to be up and 200.
#   --allow-dirty         build even though /opt/nxeon has uncommitted changes

#                         committed HEAD is built).
set -euo pipefail

DRY_RUN=0; ACCEPT_DATA_LOSS=0; INSTALL_UNITS=0; SKIP_STAGING_CHECK=0; ALLOW_DIRTY=0
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$a" in
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
    --accept-data-loss) ACCEPT_DATA_LOSS=1 ;;
    --install-units) INSTALL_UNITS=1 ;;
    --build-local) BUILD_MODE=local ;;
    --skip-staging-check) SKIP_STAGING_CHECK=1 ;;

    -h|--help) sed -n '2,49p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "unknown option: $a (see --help)" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

LIBDIR="$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")/lib"
source "$LIBDIR/seamless-env-production.sh"
# shellcheck source=lib/seamless-release.sh
source "$LIBDIR/seamless-release.sh"

hook_preflight() {
  if [ "$SKIP_STAGING_CHECK" != 1 ]; then
    systemctl is-active -q nxeon-staging-web || die "Refusing to promote: staging web service is not running (--skip-staging-check to override)."
    local code; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 15 http://127.0.0.1:8080/ || true)
    [ "$code" = 200 ] || die "Refusing to promote: staging returns HTTP $code (--skip-staging-check to override)."
    log "Staging is at $(git -C /opt/nxeon-staging rev-parse --short HEAD) and answers 200"
  fi
  local dirty; dirty=$(git -C "$APP_DIR" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)
  if [ -n "$dirty" ]; then
    echo "$dirty" | head -20 | sed 's/^/    /' >&2
    [ "$ALLOW_DIRTY" = 1 ] || die "/opt/nxeon has uncommitted changes to tracked files (above). Commit them first — only the committed HEAD is built. (--allow-dirty to build HEAD anyway.)"
    warn "building committed HEAD; the uncommitted changes above are NOT included"
  fi
}

# Schema first (as before): additive changes are safe for the still-running old
# code, and the new build may prerender against them. Uses the BUILD tree's
# schema (= the commit being deployed) and production's DATABASE_URL, passed
# explicitly into a scrubbed environment.
hook_schema() {
  local dburl; dburl=$(db_url_of_env_file "$APP_DIR/.env")
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then
    log "Schema (dry run): SQL a db push would apply to '$EXPECT_DB':"
    (cd "$BUILD_DIR" && clean_env DATABASE_URL="$dburl" npx prisma migrate diff \
       --from-url "$dburl" --to-schema-datamodel "$BUILD_DIR/prisma/schema.prisma" --script 2>&1 | tail -40 | sed 's/^/    /') || warn "could not compute the schema diff"
    return 0
  fi
  local flags=(--skip-generate --schema="$BUILD_DIR/prisma/schema.prisma") mode="additive only"
  if [ "$ACCEPT_DATA_LOSS" = 1 ]; then flags+=(--accept-data-loss); mode="--accept-data-loss"; fi
  log "Applying database schema to '$EXPECT_DB' ($mode)"
  local out rc=0
  out=$(cd "$BUILD_DIR" && clean_env DATABASE_URL="$dburl" npx prisma db push "${flags[@]}" 2>&1) || rc=$?
  echo "$out" | tail -6 | sed 's/^/    /'
  [ "$rc" = 0 ] || die "prisma db push failed/refused (exit $rc). Nothing else changed; the live app is untouched. If the warning above is a reviewed, accepted data-loss change, re-run with --accept-data-loss."
}

# The worker runs `npx tsx worker/index.ts` from /opt/nxeon's own source and
# node_modules, so it needs deps + a Prisma client generated THERE — done only
# after the web is confirmed healthy, so it can never delay the web cutover.
hook_after_web() {
  if [ "$(git -C "$APP_DIR" rev-parse HEAD)" != "$TARGET_COMMIT" ]; then

  sleep 5
  systemctl is-active "$WEB_SERVICE" "$WORKER_SERVICE" || warn "$WORKER_SERVICE is not active — check journalctl -u $WORKER_SERVICE (the web is already live and healthy)"
}

# /etc/systemd/system/nxeon-worker.service, then `systemctl daemon-reload`).
#
# Why these stop settings matter (2026-10-01): the worker drains gracefully on

# TimeoutStopSec (90s) would SIGKILL it mid-drain if a job writes slowly, and

  - Price settings `cyrus_meshgen_price_*` are defined at `lib/cyrus/meshgen/cost.ts:58-60`. `parsePrices` takes a settings object, and nothing in prod passes one.
  - The runner ships `lib/cyrus/meshgen/blender/sbx-meshgen.sh` to node-2 over ssh. `lib/cyrus/meshgen/runner.ts:12` imports `../testflight/client`.

- **Catalog v2 tools: TYPES/LIBRARY ONLY.**
  - `catalog_search`, `catalog_get` and `resolveLibrarySlot` (`lib/cyrus/library/v2/tools.ts:99, 134, 166`) are imported only by `test/cyrus-catalog-v2.test.ts`.

    - `createSqliteCatalogIndex(file=":memory:")` (`sqlite-index.ts:16`).
    - `createMemoryCatalogStore` (`pipeline.ts:29`).

  - Nothing in `lib/` touches the `CyrusCatalog*` Prisma models (grep for `prisma` or `CyrusCatalog` in `library/v2` finds only comments).
